system.description:
Range: 10 Spaces

Cost: All Resolve (minimum of 1)

She did not finish with you the first time, but she is happy to resume where she left off.

When you or a creature within 10 spaces of you would die or begin Dying, you may spend all your Resolve (minimum of 1) for them to be remade instead.

The target does not die, and is no longer Dying. Their Wounds and Stamina are restored to 1/2 of their maximum value.

Choose Body, Mind, or Soul. That Attribute is reduced by -1 until they complete a Long Rest.

Choose a second Attribute. It is increased by +1 until they complete a Long Rest.

You cannot use this ability again until you complete a Long Rest. The target may not benefit from this ability again until all their Wounds are restored.

Effect: @UUID[Compendium.titan-vttrpg-compendium.effects.ActiveEffect.nmBxkozp0wHQzMYM]{Deathsinger's Rebirth}
